verdict.rationale: Google Authenticator is a one-time passcode generator (TOTP/HOTP) for 2-Step Verification. User-configurable autonomous background automations are a category error for this kind of product. Its automatic code sync across devices is a built-in behavior, not user-defined automation, so it does not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
